key_gap: vs baseline (v5 human won 4.6/4.4): the routed run now installs the human's decisive first-pass moves as WHY-stage contract items — animals-not-households revenue unit, penetration anchored to the published 5-6% base rate with the UK/Sweden lag-vs-ceiling bound, two independent cross-checks (~10% agreement) — so the v5 AI's only flaw (a guessed 20% 'software-like' penetration candidate it had to screen out in HOW) is class-gated before arithmetic; the closed-scope fast path recovers the efficiency gap (v5 AI 4 → 4.5) and the m011 growth-loop + dominant-factor sensitivity statements add depth. Residual gap: the human's five-line trace is still leaner and its insight phrasing ('insure the animal, not the household') is cleaner than the AI's machinery-mediated equivalent.
learning_signal: Fermi market sizing wins when the dominant factor is anchored BEFORE alternatives are generated: revenue unit chosen explicitly (insured animals, not households; seats, not companies), penetration held to a published base rate with an international bound, >=1 independent cross-check within ~2x, order-of-magnitude stated, and the decision readout (what share is buildable) derived from the size rather than embedded in it. The v6 m054 chain contract (TAM/SAM/SOM from population x segment x penetration x price, every factor shown, dominant-factor sensitivity stated, penetration-guess caveat) plus the P1 factor-class gate turn the human's first-pass discipline into a standing requirement, and the compounding-growth line makes the number quotable against the right time base.
suggested_improvement: Keep the m054 chain contract + P1 factor-class gate (estimate-without-anchor is gated at WHY) on all g:estimate sizing signatures, with the excluded unanchored guess named in the packet's risks; add a growth-loop line (compounding base rate) to the dominant-factor sensitivity statement so the share readout is tied to today's base; keep the P8 fast path on fully-specified sizing briefs; the m011 falsifiable observable (insured-pet census year-over-year) should ship in the packet's evidence field as the re-check trigger.

key_gap: vs baseline (v5 AI won 4.8/3.0): the pure style validated its registry weakness — an invented 10% penetration became crisp 'TAM ≈ $4.5B', which then set the revenue target and the Series A narrative. The v6 routed run keeps the v5 AI's range-only answer (p = 2-30% -> $0.9B-$13.5B, 15x span) and adds first-class passes that harden it: the m019 adversary gate (R3, adversarial) quantifies the exploit vectors of a point figure (target mis-setting ~3x hiring, narrative anchoring), m044 maps each stakeholder's exposure to false precision, m070 weights the evidence toward the only supported end (today run-rate $1-3B), and the 0.07% required-penetration inversion shows the go/no-go is capacity-governed. Residual gap: dual-route + m019 gate cost a pass vs the v5 single route (efficiency 5 -> 4.5), and the range's midpoint remains quotable if the memo's lead (inversion first) is skipped.
learning_signal: When the dominant factor of a sizing chain carries no anchor, a point estimate is a preference, not a finding: output the range with the carrying factor's span named, state decision sensitivity explicitly (go/no-go unchanged across the full span -> say so), invert (compute the penetration the target requires) instead of deriving the target from TAM, label TAM vs SAM vs obtainable before any comparison, flag pre-existing beliefs as anchors, attach an evidence plan as the stated precondition for any point figure, and quantify each stakeholder's exposure to the false-precision figure. A market size that cannot change a decision is theater; producing it crisply is a calibration failure even with perfect arithmetic.
suggested_improvement: Keep the adversarial -> m019 gate on sizing signatures and add 'lead with the evidence-supported end of the range' (run-rate first, unmeasured upside second) to the m054 contract's deck shape; extend the m019 'quantified exposure per vector' line with the required-penetration inversion on every decision-relevant target; NEEDS_EVIDENCE stays the terminal state for unanchored-dominant-factor sizings until the evidence plan delivers pilot/base-rate data; add the stakeholder map (m044) to the packet's risks whenever the memo is decision- or narrative-consumed.
